OpenSCM: Open Supply Chain Model, release 2 (based on ORWiki)

This site is a preview. The model stays free under CC BY-SA; paid services built around it may follow.

What it is. A model of operations and supply chain, built with Archi®, the open-source ArchiMate® tool, and based on the ORWiki open reference. The structure stays faithful to ORWiki. This release adds AI-written summary text to 1,043 elements and flows, and draws every part as navigable diagrams generated from the model.

First time here? Read How to navigate this model (one page).

What this release lacks (we say it openly). Some flows between processes still have no description; texts are uneven in length and precision; 13 of 41 capabilities have no process yet; links between areas are missing. Full list: What's missing.

Where it is going (no dates):

  1. Next release: close the gaps, with every element described and texts consistent in size and precision.
  2. Then: missing links added, the structure revised, and the content as a book.
  3. Then: a release with newly written descriptions, built with all of the above.

Get involved. This is a share-alike, community model. Use Feedback on any page, or email me. Contributors are welcome, especially people who work in supply chain and people who use Archi. If there is enough interest, a shared contribution space (GitHub plus an open chat channel) will follow.

Previous version. The March 2026 release is still online: boraperzic.github.io/ORWiki.
